instruction: An alpine village on a snowy evening: timber chalets with glowing amber windows and thick snow caps, a slender church spire with a lit clock, falling snowflakes, a horse-drawn sleigh on the lane, snow-laden pines, a frozen pond with skate trails, stacked firewood, street lanterns with halos, and chimney smoke rising into the dusk.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Snowy Alpine Village. An alpine village on a snowy evening: timber chalets with glowing amber windows and thick snow caps, a slender church spire with a lit clock, falling snowflakes, a horse-drawn sleigh on the lane, snow-laden pines, a frozen pond with skate trails, stacked firewood, street lanterns with halos, and chimney smoke rising into the dusk. Style: cozy winter storybook. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
